##: Scoop requires a non-empty url (Get-SupportedArchitecture). aria2 (official 1.37 AND aria2-next) exits 0 on unsupported file:// URIs without downloading anything, so Scoop's fallback never triggers and clean installs crash on the missing cache file. Therefore the url is a tiny, stable https payload (the Ghost manifest from the user's dsh bucket; its content is irrelevant) renamed to scoop-deepclean.ps1; pre_install then overwrites it with the real script copied from the bucket. Works with every engine: official aria2 / aria2-next / ghost-shim / built-in.
description: My Scoop Tools - scoop-deepclean: one-click deep cleanup (scoop cleanup * + scoop cache rm * + bun/uv/pnpm cache with per-item confirmation; prompts to kill locking processes; uv cache-lock aware). aria2ghost: routes Scoop's aria2 downloads through Ghost Downloader CLI (ghd) with automatic aria2 fallback; manage via scoop-aria2ghost status|deploy|restore.
notes: aria2ghost: Scoop downloads go through Ghost Downloader CLI (ghd.exe); without Ghost they fall back to the backed-up aria2 engine automatically.
The https url is only a dummy payload to satisfy Scoop's architecture check (file:// breaks aria2 silently); real tools are copied from the bucket by pre_install.
aria2 is held after install to protect the shim; after 'scoop unhold aria2' + update, run 'scoop-aria2ghost deploy' to repair.
After editing: build.ps1 -> test.ps1 -> bump version -> git commit -> git -C D:\Scoop\buckets\mytools pull -> scoop update myScoopTools (quick refresh: -f -k).
